summary.en: Classic Snake written in strikingly little code, with both wrap-around and solid-wall modes.
summary.zh: 经典贪吃蛇，代码极简，支持穿墙与撞墙两种模式。

description.en: Steer with the arrow keys, eat food to grow longer and score higher. Touch your own tail and the run ends; the walls kill or wrap depending on the mode.
description.zh: 方向键控制蛇头，吃到食物身体变长得分，撞到自己或边界（可选穿墙）即结束。

tip.en: One of the smallest entries at a few dozen kilobytes — zero loading friction. Tiny tweaks like an invincibility mode or speed power-ups spin it into fresh variants, so it gets reused endlessly.
tip.zh: 体积最小的一类（几十 KB），加载零负担。可加「无敌模式」「加速道具」等小改动做变体，复用性极高。
